integrity: The universal statement is proved symbolically from the prime-power formula for the Gaussian Euler function, an explicit quotient bound, and an exact signed-prime factorization.
The finite verifier is corroborative only and is not used to infer the infinite classification.
The primary source and exact database entries were compared at statement level, including the two-prime theorem and the stated proper-divisor question.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to odd G-Lehmer numbers with exactly three distinct prime factors.
It neither proves infinitude of either parametrized family nor classifies four-prime or higher-support G-Lehmer numbers.
It does not settle the global proper-divisor question.
title: Exact three-prime parametrization for \(G\)-Lehmer numbers
